Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the incident on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim has been approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. According to your policy, [COLL-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

The net payment to you is {PAYOUT}. The {DEDUCTIBLE} is the deductible that has already been subtracted from this amount.

Payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions, please contact us.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
